mission_02: Congratulations! You've learned essential data type validation techniques in pandas. By using astype() for direct conversion, pd.to_numeric() with errors='coerce' for safe numeric conversion, and custom functions for boolean parsing, you now have a toolkit for handling messy input data. These skills are critical when ingesting data from CSV files, APIs, or databases where type information may be lost or inconsistent. Remember that type validation should be one of the first steps in any data cleaning pipeline.
